summary: TGE, a NYSE/LSE-listed AMTD-controlled hospitality vehicle, furnished a 6-K disclosing its November 2, 2026 closing of the acquisition of four premium hotel assets from affiliate AMTD Digital under an October 21, 2026 Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement. Aggregate purchase price was US$209,766,000, including underlying debt, satisfied entirely by issuance of 198,630,381 new Class A ordinary shares priced off the 30-day VWAP for the thirty trading days ending May 29, 2026. Assets: 100% Tribeca Hotel, 50% Ritz-Carlton Perth with veto rights, 100% Dao by Dorsett Hornsey London, and 80% Upper Regalia Kuala Lumpur. This is a related-party asset injection consolidating AMTD hospitality holdings under TGE; watch share overhang and affiliate control dilution.
